<function name="MainEyePos" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Returns the origin of the main view, as it was at the start of the latest main view render.

This is a good alternative to <page>Global.EyePos</page> which is affected by other rendering operations, including <page>render.RenderView</page>.
	</description>
	<added>2025.10.02</added>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">Main camera position.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
